jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad

**Job Posting Title:** Senior Associate Software Engineer Salesforce

**Workday Job Profile:** Senior Associate Software Engineer

**Department Name:** Digital, Technology \& Innovation – Ops Client Facing Technology

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description**


We are seeking a skilled Senior Associate Software Engineer Salesforce, to drive the development, deployment, support, and continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions across Production and non\-Production environments. This role requires deep hands\-on expertise in Salesforce development, Salesforce Experience Cloud (Communities), Agile practices, and governance.


The ideal candidate will serve as the primary technical expert for Salesforce engineering operations, ensuring platform stability, scalability, compliance, and high\-quality delivery while collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders.

**Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Provide day\-to\-day support for Production and non\-Production Salesforce environments of Artemis ( Clinical Artwork tool) within the Amgen Regulated environment.
* Hands\-on experience with the Salesforce Lightning Platform (Aura and/or LWC) and understanding of core Salesforce configuration capabilities.
* Experience with MuleSoft, including supporting APIs, monitoring integrations, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting connectivity or data flow issues between Salesforce and external systems like Veeva.
* Support integrations between Salesforce and external platforms like Veeva with , MuleSoft as middleware. Monitoring jobs, performing initial issue triage, and escalating complex defects as needed.
* Experience with Single sign on integration with platforms like Okta or Microsoft Entra and experience in configuring workflow using email notifications.
* Hands\-on experience with electronic signatures preferred.
* Follow established coding standards and participate in peer reviews to maintain security, performance, and compliance standards, including adherence to VeraCode requirements
* Work with Compliance team on periodic audits and reviews. Operate in a regulated environment and comply with all required policies, documentation, and audit standards.
* Assist in developing and maintaining configured solutions, Visualforce pages, and Lightning components within Service Cloud and Commerce Cloud.
* Resolve routine support tickets and defects, ensuring timely updates and communication with stakeholders.
* Work with cybersecurity and compliance teams to address identified vulnerabilities during code review and support required governance processes.
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (PI Planning, Sprint Planning, stand\-ups) and provide updates on assigned tasks.
* Follow established best practices to ensure maintainability and scalability of solutions.
* Participate in proof\-of\-concept activities and support exploration of emerging capabilities, including AI/ML use cases.
* Lead Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, and technical estimation activities.
* Mentor junior developers and provide technical leadership for the Salesforce Artemis product team.
* Experience with GIT or similar version control systems
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline processes
* Preferred \- Experience in Supply chain or Clinical Supply chain.
* Preferred \- experience working in validated environment and familiarity with GXP processes.

**Soft Skills:**

* Effective collaboration in cross\-functional and distributed teams
* Strong initiative and self\-drive in a dynamic environment
* Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
* Ability to collaborate with QA, compliance, validation, and security teams
* Ability to handle and prioritize numerous tasks effectively
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Willingness to mentor junior developers and share best practices
* Adaptability to work in a fast\-paced, evolving technical landscape.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 3 to 5 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience OR
* Diploma and 7 to 9 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience

**Professional Certifications:**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I (required).
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (required).
* Salesforce Administrator or App Builder Certification (preferred).
* SAFe Agile Certification (preferred).

* Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
* We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in operations or business management, and vendor management.
* 7 years of experience using analytics or applying project management tools to address business issues.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Project Management certifications such as PMP, Six Sigma, etc.
* Experience with managing digital advertising, Google Ads, campaign building and optimization.
* Experienced with the GCS Incentive system (Points, UAAs, Spend Bands, Offerings, etc).
* Experience in early customer lifecycle stages (i.e. Onboarding and Acquisition).
* Understanding of selling best practice and techniques (e.g., objection handling, competitive selling).
* Excellent sales performance analysis skills, along with the ability to manage sales activities and metrics, diagnose performance issues, and translate insights into recommendations.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Vendor Performance Manager (VPM), you will play a critical role on the frontlines of Google Customer Solutions (GCS) vendor sales management. You will be the principal stakeholder for your vendor management team, influencing and holding them accountable to deliver excellent sales performance and quality while enabling site\-program success with targeted support.


You will be responsible for analyzing vendor performance and presenting key insights to Google sales leadership, supporting initiatives to improve GCS vendor operations, and sharing best practices with vendor management and Google teams across global markets and lines of business.  

  

This role is aligned to the AUNZ market and will require working non standard hours.


The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build quarterly strategy in collaboration with vendor leaders, monitor weekly sales performance metrics, and share key market performance insights with Google sales leadership via weekly updates and monthly reviews.
* Ensure vendor service quality against contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) by conducting regular call audits, calibration sessions, and quality reviews.
* Build influential, trusted partner relationships with vendor sales management (e.g., Senior Manager), communicating rigorous expectations for delivering against program\-specific agreement terms while providing appropriate support, best practices, and guidance.
* Provide critical on\-the\-ground feedback and support to land vendor operations improvement initiatives led by central Google teams.
* Find opportunities and execute on cross GCS collaborations to enable smooth customer outreach, graduations, and more.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields.
* 8 years of experience in business strategy, technology research, anti\-abuse, policy, data analytics, cyber\-security, program management or related fields.
* 2 years of experience in people management, leading teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant field.
* Education in, or experience with, machine learning.
* Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization/dashboards, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).
* Experience working with engineering and product teams to create tools, solutions, or automation to improve user safety.
* Experience working closely with policy teams.
* Ability to translate complex data analyses and emerging abuse trends into actionable business strategies for non\-technical stakeholders and leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------


Trust \& Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.



Our team has the critical mission of protecting and respecting Google's users, ensuring online safety in both core and emerging areas. We are at the center of the company\-wide charge to raise the bar on content, including coherent policies and scaled and effective enforcement. We have recently expanded beyond traditional product protections focusing on additional types of abuse: brand safety, controversial content, violent extremism, and political interference. We've advanced user protections, and demonstrated expertise across Google’s growing array of products and services.


In this role, you’ll lead a team, be a thought leader, an excellent operator and will collaborate cross\-functionally. You will bring passion for abuse fighting, focus on putting the user first and lead a high performing team to deliver excellent business results. You will partner with key stakeholders to drive operational performance and lower abuse rates.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect the roadmap for global ads defense. Oversee the deployment of analytical frameworks and fraud\-detection methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate content that violates Google Ads policies, staying one step ahead of evolving adversarial tactics.
* Lead strategic cross\-functional initiatives by partnering with executive stakeholders across product, engineering, legal, Public Relation (PR), and public policy to influence long\-term technical roadmaps, roll out policy updates, and ensure safer\-by\-design product features.
* Forge and scale a team of subject matter experts. Advocate a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety, ensuring your team remains resilient and high\-performing while navigating the rapid pace and sensitive nature of global ads content and policies.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

ServiceNow is changing the way people work. With a service\-orientation toward the activities, tasks and processes that make up day\-to\-day work life, we help the modern enterprise operate faster and be more scalable than ever before.


We are looking for a Staff Product Manager who can help lead the effort to build a consumer\-grade user experience for ServiceNow’s products. Our users are the employees of the world’s largest companies and our mission is to provide them a user experience at work that is comparable to the user experiences they are used to using at home.


You will be a member of the product team that is responsible for building the consumer\-grade web, mobile and conversational experiences that make up our AI front door to work, where an employee asks, acts and accomplishes in one place, across ServiceNow’s business units.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Contributing to the ServiceNow vision for how employees get their work done, across interfaces and business units
* Partnering with PMs across ServiceNow business units to understand their products and use cases and champion enhancements needed for a better service experience
* Working with the UX design and research teams to design and validate awesome cross\-interface experiences that balance the different outcomes involved in service experiences
* Crafting content that evangelizes our vision for a consumer\-grade employee experience – both for internal stake holders and customers.

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Has 7\+ years in product management with experience building consumer or employee facing user interfaces. Plus points for experience with B2B SaaS products and for having built mobile experiences.
* Is AI\-native in how they work and in what they build, has shipped AI\-powered experiences, and holds a point of view on where AI belongs in an employee experience and where it does not
* Strong attention to detail, with the technical depth to partner with engineering and the design sensibility to partner with UX
* Enjoys collaborating with other teams, leading by influence and by evangelizing a vision
* Thinks holistically about the business objectives, collaborating cross\-functionally to drive GTM workstreams e.g. customer \& partner enablement, beyond delivering great product .
* Thrives in ambiguity and enjoys working in a fast paced and collaborative environment
* Has exceptional presentation skills and the ability to relate to various level of stakeholders, including communicating with senior leadership and managing stakeholders across business units.
* Has experience working in an agile product management environment; writing stories, grooming with developers, managing sprints etc
* Brings energy, curiosity, independence, humility and a sense of humor to the office every day.

  

We provide competitive compensation, generous benefits and a professional atmosphere. This is a very collaborative and inclusive work environment where individuals strong on aptitude and attitude will have an opportunity to grow their professional careers through working with some of the most advanced technology and talented developers in the business.

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

jobs.title: Product Supply Planning Manager
jobs.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. Our Supply Chain team is growing, and we are looking to strengthen it with a passionate and driven team member. If you are eager to be part of a dynamic, global, and fast\-growing organization—where a positive mindset, personal development, and making a meaningful impact on people's health are valued—we could be the perfect match. As Product Supply Planning Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end supply plan for our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), collaborate across departments, and play an active role in shaping the future of our company.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Create and maintain the supply plan for CMOs on a monthly basis, considering inventory and open orders (firmed and planned), to identify and communicate status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Based on the supply plan, issue Purchase Orders and forecasts to CMOs, and monitor deliveries of purchase orders against requested dates.
* Proactively manage supply constraints to minimize business impact.
* Provide accurate and complete supply planning parameters and purchasing conditions for all SKUs; act as the Expert User for key planning Master Data.
* Set and maintain all required Master Data and ensure its integrity and correctness.
* Create and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Oversee the successful launch of new products into the market, ensuring timely supply, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with manufacturing and distribution teams.
* Propose stock holding levels within the supply chain through a detailed understanding of key planning parameters and the E2E process (safety stock, lead times, supply reliability, demand variability, service objectives), in line with Working Capital targets.
* Perform monthly inventory reconciliations, ensure inventory accuracy, and minimize discrepancies.


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of proven experience in end\-to\-end (E2E) planning within the pharmaceutical industry, including direct interaction with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities and evolving business needs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with excellent communication abilities.
* Proven track record of effective collaboration with both internal cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently.
* Quick learner with a proactive and adaptable mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Familiarity with Oracle ERP systems; functional knowledge is an advantage.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) or equivalent supply chain qualification.
* Experience supporting new product introductions/launches in a regulated (GMP) pharmaceutical environment.
* Experience working across multiple time zones with global CMO networks.


By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.

* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs.  The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech on the DSP\-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end\-to\-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off\-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last\-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000\+ Delivery Associates.
   

  

 This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off\-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off\-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi\-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
   

  

 We are in the early stages of a multi\-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next\-generation experience looks like.
   

  

 This is a global role requiring cross\-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one\-way and two\-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post\-launch, the Sr. Product Manager\-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface\-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
   

  

 We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long\-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. jobs.title: Product Manager - Agentic
jobs.description:
**About This Role** 



* We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
* You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale.
* This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
* You'll report directly to the
 **Product Director** 
 and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact.
* This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Strategic ownership** 



* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities



  





**Execution leadership** 



* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively



  





**Partnership with platform PMs** 



* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success



  





**We're Looking For** 




**Experience shipping one or more of the following:** 




 AI\-native products or features that users love · Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on) · Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization · Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas · Experiences that balance power with usability.
 



  





**Core capabilities** 



* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

jobs.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

 Job Description: Product Manager II
   

  

**Role Summary**
 F5 Digital is building the enterprise AI muscle that will power the next generation of intelligent, secure, and scalable internal platforms. We are seeking an AI Product Manager II to own our AI model ecosystem, token economy, and core agentic platform enablement.
   

  

 This role is responsible for the end\-to\-end management of our LLM stack, developer\-facing AI resources, and token economics. Beyond managing costs and access, this PM will actively support F5’s agentic transformation, building the tools, documentation, and developer experience that make it seamless for engineering teams to build secure and scalable AI agents.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically curious, and passionate about the rapidly evolving LLM and agentic software frameworks, combining product execution with a strong focus on developer enablement and platform economics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Model Ecosystem Management**
* Own the lifecycle of AI models within F5, evaluating, onboarding, and managing access to the latest foundational models (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, open\-source models).
* Partner with platform engineering to ensure seamless, secure, and observable model integration into our developer environments.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving LLM landscape to guide internal development teams toward the right architectures and models.


**Agentic Transformation \& Developer Enablement**
* Serve as the product owner for developer\-facing tooling, SDKs, and APIs that facilitate agentic AI development.
* Support teams across F5 in transitioning from simple prompt\-engineering to complex, multi\-agent workflows and systems.
* Create and curate high\-quality developer resources, sample code, and onboarding paths to accelerate internal agent deployment.


**Token Economics \& Platform Efficiency**
* Own the enterprise token economy: track usage patterns, forecast capacity, and develop optimized pricing and chargeback models.
* Define and track key platform metrics, including model latency, token efficiency, usage anomalies, and cost\-per\-query.
* Partner with Finance and Cloud FinOps to manage and project enterprise AI spend while scaling capacity.


**Governance \& Responsible AI**
* Ensure model access and agent integrations adhere to strict corporate security, privacy, and data governance policies.
* Implement guardrails, logging patterns, and cost controls to reduce model risk and mitigate shadow AI across developer groups.


**Product Ownership \& Execution**
* Manage and prioritize the backlog for model hosting, API routing, token metrics, and developer enablement tools.
* Lead Agile sprints and collaborate closely with systems, platform, and security engineers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3\+ years of Product Management experience delivering developer platforms, APIs, SaaS, or technical infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI fundamentals (LLMs, API integrations, context windows, token consumption, and model routing).
* Familiarity with agentic concepts (e.g., tool\-calling, agent frameworks, MCP, orchestrators) and a desire to help developers build agents.
* Highly analytical with experience monitoring technical metrics, usage data, cloud spend, or subscription economics.
* Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to build trust with engineering teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with developer platforms, technical documentation, or internal developer relations (DevRel).
* Understanding of cloud governance, FinOps, or managing usage costs for API platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) or secure hosting platforms (Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock).


**What Success Looks Like**
* Maintain a streamlined, secure model\-onboarding pipeline that keeps F5 at the absolute forefront of AI technology.
* Build an intuitive developer experience that reduces the time\-to\-first\-agent for internal engineering teams.
* Establish a completely transparent, observable, and cost\-effective token\-tracking model.
* Mitigate security and cost risk by migrating developers away from unmanaged third\-party APIs to the secure, internal ecosystem.


**Why Join F5 Digital?**
 This is an opportunity to help shape F5’s enterprise AI foundation and build a platform that empowers every team to innovate responsibly with AI. You will work at the intersection of AI strategy, platform engineering, governance, and real\-world business impact—defining how F5 scales intelligent automation across the company.

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  



As a Digital Product Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the processes related to the definition and delivery of digital products. You will develop functional specifications, including capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, based on feedback from internal and external stakeholders. You will collaborate with business and technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize features, and drive successful product delivery.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate capabilities, define solution alternatives, and prioritize product releases
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and feature requirements to development teams
* Work closely with UX and engineering teams to shape product design and user experience
* Generate release notes, demo scripts, and conduct product demonstrations for stakeholders and clients
* Independently identify and analyze relevant data to support product decisions and business cases
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of product capabilities and feature requirements
* Drive continuous improvement by acting on feedback received during retrospectives and product reviews
* Identify potential risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies
* Foster a culture of innovation across the product portfolio
* Collaborate effectively with onsite and offshore teams to assess requirements and deliver solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Allied Health Sciences, MCA, or a related field
* 5\+ years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years in Healthcare Informatics, Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analysis roles
* Experience in Healthcare, Pharmacy, PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Management), or related healthcare technology domains
* Experience defining capabilities, features, user stories, wireframes, and acceptance criteria
* Proven experience managing product backlogs and working within Agile product development frameworks
* Experience collaborating with development teams throughout feature implementation and delivery
* Solid understanding of healthcare workflows, pharmacy systems, prescription adjudication, specialty pharmacy operations, and member journeys
* Proven solid analytical, logical reasoning, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare, or a related discipline
* Experience with voice, digital, self\-service, IVR, contact center, chatbot, conversational AI, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience launching MVPs and managing products through the entire product lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Rally, Aha!, or similar product management and requirements management tools
* Knowledge of Optum domain, prescription adjudication systems, specialty pharmacy subsystems, and prescription member workflows

 **About Optum**


Optum specializes in the delivery, clinical management, and affordability of prescription medications and consumer health products. Our goal is to deliver high\-quality, integrated services that promote optimal outcomes, superior savings, and outstanding client and consumer experiences.


At Optum, we are dedicated to helping make the health system work better for everyone. As part of a global organization, you'll have the opportunity to work on innovative healthcare solutions that impact millions of lives while collaborating with talented teams across business and technology.


Join us and help shape the future of healthcare through digital innovation.

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Science Annotation Ops Analyst
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about building scalable data pipelines and dashboards that power machine learning innovation? Do you thrive at the intersection of data engineering, AWS cloud architecture, and automation? Join the Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce \& Sustainability team where your technical expertise will directly support high\-quality training data that fuels ML models—helping Amazon achieve zero waste, zero cost of returns, and zero defects.  

  

As a Science Annotation Operations Analyst, you'll own end\-to\-end data pipelines that extract, validate, and consolidate annotation metrics from AWS and SageMaker. You'll build production dashboards, create custom annotation interfaces, and automate critical workflows—all while collaborating with Program Managers, Science Specialists, and cross\-functional teams. This role offers you the opportunity to leverage Python, AWS services, and web development skills to solve real problems that impact both customers and the planet.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain scalable data pipelines that extract, parse, validate, and consolidate annotation metrics from AWS and SageMaker, ensuring data quality and auditability throughout the lifecycle
* Build and operate production dashboards on EC2 covering the full data lifecycle (ingest, validate, score, publish) using technologies like Plotly Dash or Streamlit
* Implement secure, least\-privilege cross\-account AWS integrations using IAM, STS, Lambda, and API Gateway to enable seamless data ingestion from multiple source accounts
* Develop custom SageMaker Ground Truth labeling templates using HTML and JavaScript with conditional logic that transform written SOPs into validated annotation interfaces
* Automate recurring manual processes including monthly consolidation, historical backfills, and scheduled jobs while maintaining alerting, backups, and deployment workflows to improve operational efficiency

  

A day in the life  

You'll collaborate with Program Managers, Leads, and Science Annotations Specialists to tackle technical challenges that span the data lifecycle. You could start with debugging a Python script that processes annotation metrics with pandas and boto3, followed by deploying a new dashboard feature to EC2\. Later, you could be writing SQL queries to validate data quality, configuring IAM policies for secure cross\-account access, or building a new annotation UI template in HTML and JavaScript. You'll use Git for version control and Linux command\-line tools to manage deployment workflows, all while serving as the technical POC for your team.  

  

About the team  

The Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce \& Sustainability team is dedicated to making zero happen—zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We're an agile and inclusive organization that innovates to create long\-term value by investing in our people and our planet. Our team spans business, product, operations, data, and software engineering disciplines working together to manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products.  

  

You'll partner across teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used and open box items, improve the returns experience, and reduce waste in reverse logistics. As part of this mission\-driven team, you'll be a builder and an owner, collaborating cross\-functionally to design scalable solutions. At Amazon, Earth is our customer too—join us and help innovate for a more sustainable future.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree within last 12 months in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields, or experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
* Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS
* Experience building web based dashboards using common frameworks

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* SageMaker Ground Truth experience
* ML / annotation\-operations domain familiarity
* Experience standardizing metrics and processes across teams

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Everyday Essentials Experiences
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Everyday Essentials Experience Org delivers a world\-class shopping experience for everyday essentials that is efficient, habitual, and economical for customers and selling partners. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong ownership and a drive to solve complex, large\-scale problems through creative solutions.  

  

The Everyday Essential Cost to Serve team drives multi\-million dollar cost savings for Amazon through its multipack programs. The team owns how Amazon represents, prices, and fulfills multipack products worldwide, and is currently executing a ground\-up re\-architecture of the multipack platform as a leadership\-priority initiative, promoting multipacks to first\-class purchasable products. This work changes how millions of customers discover, purchase, and receive multipacks, and how selling partners manage their multipack catalog.  

  

What makes this role unique is the breadth. Your work will span the entire retail funnel: ASIN creation, catalog ingestion, pricing determination, selection and ranking, and customer\-facing experiences on Search, Detail Page, Cart, Checkout,  

and the multipacks storefront. You will work closely with the science team and have the opportunity to develop and influence the models that drive multipack selection and personalization. Few teams at Amazon offer this combination of  

end\-to\-end systems exposure.  

  

You will build systems that separate what a customer buys from how it is fulfilled, enabling seamless multipack experiences from online multipacks fulfilled with individual units to physical products shipped as a single item. You will have the freedom to experiment, propose new multipack experiences, and ship them worldwide. Your ideas move from whiteboard to production, visible to hundreds of millions of customers. You will shape foundational decisions in an active re\-architecture program with high visibility to senior leadership  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Design, build, and own end\-to\-end software solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable across the full software development lifecycle.
  

Collaborate with product managers, principal engineers, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and working software.
  

Drive continuous improvement by identifying gaps in existing systems, proposing solutions, and delivering results with a high bar for quality and operational excellence.
  

Participate actively in code reviews, contribute to team best practices, and mentor junior engineers to raise the technical bar across the team.  

Operate with a good sense of ownership — monitoring systems you build, responding to operational issues, and iterating quickly to improve customer and partner experience.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.

jobs.title: Product Manager II ( Poster )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight—when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

**Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: To connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the knowledge, opportunities, tools, and experts they've always deserved.**
**We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:**
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers (AstroLokal)
* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight \+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a WhatsApp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
   

  

**Requirements**
 About Posters
   

  

 Posters is Lokal's visual expression engine. Users in Bharat love sharing daily greetings, festival wishes, political support, and social updates with their networks. Posters empowers our audience to effortlessly create, personalize, and share high
   

  

 quality visual content in their own regional languages. By providing highly relevant, easy\-to\-use templates for every occasion, we are building a sticky daily habit that drives immense engagement, viral growth, and social sharing across the Lokal ecosystem.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

* End\-to\-End Product Ownership: Full ownership of the Posters product area, measured by core business outcomes (Daily


 Active Users, shares per user, template conversion rates, retention, and monetization strategies), rather than just feature
   

  

 output.
   

  

* Growth \& Virality Funnels: Tight collaboration with content and marketing teams. The funnel starts with surfacing highly


 relevant regional templates and ends with a user proudly sharing them on their WhatsApp status. You connect content
   

  

 creation to seamless social delivery.
   

  

* Deep Data Analytics: Read user sharing behavior from data, run 2nd and 3rd level digging to find the real drivers of


 virality, and know when to stop over\-analyzing and just ship a new creator tool or feed update.
   

  

* Personalization \& Discovery: Ship MVPs fast (category\-specific templates, localized festival feeds), and build the business


 case for ML\-driven personalization to surface the perfect poster for every user, every day.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* Scale: Experience on high\-MAU, consumer\-facing products at scale (ideally in content, social, or creative tools)
* User Empathy: You can define sharp personas, deeply understand jobs\-to\-be\-done (e.g., "I want to look knowledgeable


 and updated on my WhatsApp status"), and have the toolkit to build that understanding quickly in a new language market.
   

  

* Agility \& Rigor: Comfort balancing rigor and speed. You practice A/B discipline without falling into analysis paralysis
* Domain Expertise: A proven method for acquiring domain understanding fast through user interviews, funnel teardowns,


 churn research, and competitive analysis of content\-sharing platforms.
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

  

* Vernacular or India\-specific consumer product experience
* Experience with social sharing loops, viral growth, or content\-creation and template\-driven products

**About Us**
 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
   

  

 Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
   

  

 Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our 2000\+
 **stores, distribution centers and headquarters** 
 . Target invests 75% of annual capital investment into Properties, and over half of the enterprise OpEx, leading to significant opportunity to impact outcomes for the business. We have an ambitious goal to launch hundreds of new stores over the next 10 years, with several hundred more remodels in stores, all driving new customers and incremental sales for Target.
   

  

 Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading\-edge design, development, construction and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large\-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place as a Product Manager on Target Properties Product team and help us make the most of Target’s physical footprint both in the U.S. and overseas.
   

  

 Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.
   

  

 As a Product Manager – GSCL Maintenance Operations, you will own the day\-to\-day product management for the work delivered in partnership with the Target in India Product Engineering team.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to help modernize Target’s Global Supply Chain Asset Management as part of a multi\-year transformation by moving from a highly customized legacy system to industry\-standard, out\-of\-the\-box Enterprise Asset Management capabilities for our Supply Chain Teams. The transformation will establish a more scalable and sustainable foundation for asset lifecycle visibility, standardized maintenance workflows, mobile execution, safety, workforce planning and scheduling, materials and inventory management, asset health, and predictive maintenance. This work will help reduce downtime, improve maintenance productivity, strengthen data quality and transparency, and enable better total\-cost\-of\-ownership decisions across Target’s supply chain network.
   

  

 Over the next several years, the team will establish the new Asset Management foundation and launch and scale across the network to eventually enable advanced asset\-health and predictive\-maintenance capabilities.
   

  

 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.
   

  

 You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
   

  

 You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.
   

  

 Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
   

  

**About You**
* Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of product management and/or equivalent domain experience
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas, UI discovery and development)
* Strong facilitation skills that guide groups towards productive outcomes while maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams
* Curiosity with a passion for learning and contributing to a growth culture
* Product management experience in Asset Management/ Maintenance Management, or stores /properties experience preferred

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description** 




 Evervie Health is a global healthcare group focused on building and scaling high\-quality specialty care across multiple therapeutic areas. Its platform currently spans Renal Care, Oncology, and Diagnostics. We are currently building a women's healthcare brand in India, with a digital platform that sits at the center of the patient \& provider experience.
 



  






 Why is it exciting to be part of this team? The leadership team brings decades of experience in healthcare technology and operations, with experience across 5\+ countries. Six out of eight senior leaders are women passionate about changing the paradigm for healthcare access. It's a deliberately small and senior team, and you'd be the first product hire working directly alongside them.
 




  





**Role Description** 




 The Product Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru/ Hyderabad or Chennai, responsible for driving the end\-to\-end lifecycle of healthcare products on Evervie Health’s platform.
 



 What you'll own:
 


* Turn our proprietary clinical logic and the journeys built around it into specs, user stories and acceptance criteria engineers can build against. This is the hardest problem in the role with no off\-the\-shelf playbook to copy
* Own the vendor relationship as a product leader, not a coordinator: you'll run discovery, scoping and sprint reviews, and hold the build to your spec on quality, scope and timeline
* Own product quality and user testing
* Define success metrics beyond delivery i.e. accuracy, adoption, and trust in algorithmic recommendations
* Coordinate the dependencies i.e. brand assets, clinical sign\-offs, third\-party integrations
* Track compliance milestones in partnership with legal/compliance.
* Report progress, risk, and budget status to leadership on a weekly cadence
* Own the post\-launch roadmap: triage production issues with the vendor, prioritize the next cycle of features, and manage the transition from build to steady\-state managed support



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally exposure to health\-tech, fin\-tech, or another regulated or high\-trust consumer product
* An undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a top\-tier institute (IIT/ IIM/ BITS/ NIT or equivalent); someone who can hold their own technically and analytically from day one
* Demonstrated experience managing an external development vendor or agency
* Familiarity with, or strong interest in, AI/LLM\-based product features, including how to think about evaluation, confidence thresholds and failure states in a clinical\-adjacent context
* Exposure to data privacy or regulatory frameworks (India's DPDP Act, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar) is a strong plus
* A genuine ownership mentality and comfort with 0\-to\-1 ambiguity: this is an early\-stage build with a fixed launch date, evolving scope, and a very small team



  





**Why join us** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product hire. The product architecture, the spec standard, and the way this team builds are all still unwritten; you'll be the one writing them.
 



  






 Women's healthcare in India is under\-built relative to how much it matters, and we're building for the premium end of it with clinical rigor. You'll take this from before\-it\-existed to public launch, and be part of the problem\-solving journey.

*AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser\-Busch InBev. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.* 




  





*Do You Dream Big?* 




*We Need You.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




 BrewDat is ABI’s data platform, powering data products and AI solutions across all our domains – from sales and marketing to supply, finance, people, and more.
 



  





 We provide the data foundations, frameworks, and tools that enable teams across ABI to ingest, transform, govern, and serve data at scale \- following Data Mesh and Domain\-Driven Design principles.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical background to lead the Integration products of BrewDat.
 



 Your main mission is to:
 


* Build and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BrewDat’s data engineering capabilities (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Understand and prioritize user needs from data engineers, analytics engineers, ML engineers, and domain teams.
* Turn complex platform capabilities into clear, usable products that make data teams more productive and autonomous.
* Build our Integration\-as\-a\-Service platform and guide the transition from legacy middleware to cloud\-native architectures



  





 You’ll work in a cross\-functional squad alongside engineers, a Delivery Manager, architects, and governance specialists, and you’ll collaborate closely with the Adoption team, who bring users’ needs to the product area.
 



  





**KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* **Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad.
* **Discovery \& User\-Centricity**
* Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users.
* Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers.
* **Roadmap \& Delivery**
* Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture.
* **Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time\-to\-data, platform reliability, etc.
* Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value.
* Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.).
* Communicate roadmap, progress, trade\-offs, and impact clearly and frequently.
* Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage.
* **Middleware**
* Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross\-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application).



  





**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in:
* Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or
* Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components.
* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must:
* Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade\-offs with engineers.
* Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs.
* Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event\-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts.



  





**Strong skills in:** 



* Product discovery and problem framing.
* Prioritization and roadmap management.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests.
* Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Differentials)** 



* Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory:
* Cloud \& Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh.
* Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable.
* Explicitly call out experience with legacy\-to\-cloud migrations (e.g., MuleSoft to Camel\-K), Azure DevOps for delivery tracking, and deep observability tools like Datadog.



  





*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!* 




*We dream big to create future with more cheers*

 Summit Works Technology (SWTech Labs) is a boutique software engineering firm that builds mission\-critical enterprise systems for organizations that demand high reliability, performance, and long\-term maintainability. The company works primarily through referrals and long\-term relationships, embedding deeply with client teams and taking technical ownership of complex platforms.
 



  





**The job** 




 Turn a set of priorities into specifications an engineer can build from, and keep the numbers that tell everyone whether it worked. Two to Five years of experience is the expectation; curiosity and clear writing matter more than a title history.
 



  





**What you own** 




 •  Specifications the engineer can build from without a meeting — including edge cases, empty states and failure paths, which is where most junior specs fall short.
 



 •  Release coordination and quality checks. Nothing ships without someone using it end to end first, and that someone is you.
 



 •  Match rate and time\-to\-match. You will not own the strategy that moves them, but you own knowing where they stand and why they moved.
 



 •  Taxonomy maintenance — one controlled vocabulary for stage, sector, format and funding type. Providers select from it; they never invent tags.
 



 •  User research. Tens of founder interviews in month one, then a standing cadence. This is the fastest way for you to build judgement, and the fastest way for us to learn.
 



 •  Working with the Data Analyst on the weekly pack, with metric definitions signed off by the GM.
 



 •  This is not the complete list. Opportunity to work on other related/adjacent projects.
 



**What we are looking for** 




 •  Two to five years in product, associate product, business analysis, or a founding role at something small.
 



 •  Writes unusually clearly. Send us a spec, a teardown or a piece of analysis we weight this above your CV.
 



 •  Basic SQL, or the demonstrated ability to learn it inside a month. You will pull your own numbers.
 



 •  Detail\-obsessive about flows. If you have ever filed a bug report nobody asked you to file, mention it.
 



 •  Comfortable being the most junior person in most conversations, and asking the question anyway.

* **Vendor \& stakeholder management:** Manage vendor escalations and drive closure; collaborate across business, operations, architecture, engineering, network, security and application teams; translate technical impacts for non\-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
##### **Project Description:**


We are seeking a Business Analyst to bridge business requirements and technical delivery across integration, data, and enterprise software projects. The role involves working closely with stakeholders and delivery teams to understand business needs, define solution requirements, support Agile development activities, and ensure successful implementation through testing and validation.

**Location: Bangalore (Remote)**

##### **How You'll Make an Impact:**

* Engage with stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business, functional, and system requirements.
* Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, business rules, process workflows, and data\-mapping documents.
* Act as the key liaison between business users, project teams, and technical teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Maintain traceability between business objectives, solution design, development activities, test cases, and delivered outcomes.
* Support Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, requirement prioritization, sprint planning, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Perform data analysis and validation activities using SQL to support requirement discovery, impact assessments, and solution verification.
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenario preparation, defect management, and business sign\-off activities.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and provide recommendations that enhance operational efficiency and solution effectiveness.
* Contribute to the successful delivery of enterprise applications, system integrations, and data\-driven solutions while ensuring business expectations are met.

##### **What Makes You a Great Fit:**

* 4\+ years of Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise software, integration, or data\-focused projects.
* Proven ability to elicit requirements and convert complex business challenges into clear, actionable solution specifications.
* Strong expertise in business process analysis, documentation, functional requirements definition, and data\-mapping activities.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with product owners, developers, testers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and delivering high\-quality outcomes.
* Experience in regulated industries is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.

##### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary;
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement;
* A cooperative and innovative work environment;
* 20 days of paid vacation, 15 paid sick days;
* Medical insurance coverage for employees, with optional family coverage at a corporate rate;
* Support for participation in professional development opportunities (webinars, conferences, trainings, etc.);
* Regular team\-building activities and biannual company\-wide events.
