jobs.description:
**Our Team and What We’ll Accomplish Together**  

  

Workplace Options is proud to support our parent organization, TELUS Health, in recruiting a Business Intelligence Analyst.


Our team at TELUS Health is on a mission to be the most trusted wellbeing company in the world. We support the total health and well\-being of over 35 million lives globally through our clinical expertise, digital platform, and integrated health solutions.  

  

The Business Insights \& Sales Excellence team is the analytics and management\-reporting function for TELUS Health, delivering a single trusted version of the truth to leaders. The team designs and runs the Central Business Insights Hub — a consolidated front door to the organization’s key reporting across Revenue Intelligence, Sales Performance, Operational Metrics, People \& Culture, the Executive Scorecard, and an expanding roadmap. These roles add onshore capacity to build reporting, strengthen the team’s data pipelines, and accelerate delivery through AI.

**Current Opportunity: Business Intelligence Analyst**

**Term: 1 YEAR FIXED TERM CONTRACT**  

**Location:** Remote  

**Years of experience:** 2\-3 years  

**Shift Timing:** Monday \- Friday 5pm to 2am IST  

**Languages required:** English  

  

**What you will do:**


Mid\-level individual contributor who builds and maintains reporting for the Central Business Insights Hub and the data that feeds it. The role combines strong data expertise — importing data from multiple source systems, building ETL and transformation pipelines, and validating and reconciling data for accuracy — with solid data\-visualization skills, including a working knowledge of chart and graph types and how to visualize data effectively for a business audience. A core part of the role is using AI to accelerate delivery: generating and prototyping dashboards, visuals, and reporting assets, and applying AI tools to speed up data and visualization work. Familiarity with the GCP infrastructure is an asset. The specialist works to the designs and standards set by the senior team, contributing across the hub’s reporting domains.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Data \& ETL:** Import and integrate data from multiple source systems — including Salesforce, Workday, 6Sense, Finance systems, Symphoni, and SAP/HR — and build and maintain ETL and transformation pipelines that produce trusted, refreshable, reporting\-ready data.
* **Data validation \& quality:** Validate and reconcile data for accuracy and completeness, run QA checks before release, and troubleshoot data issues so reporting stays trustworthy.
* **Data visualization:** Build clear, effective dashboards and reports, selecting the right chart and graph types for the data and audience and applying sound data\-visualization and UX practice across the hub’s reporting domains.
* **Reporting delivery:** Build and maintain reporting in Tableau, Looker Studio, and Google Apps Script dashboards — using Apps Script for rapid build\-and\-publish reporting and Tableau or Looker Studio where larger data volumes require a more scalable engine.
* **AI\-assisted development**: Use AI tools to generate and prototype dashboards, visuals, and reporting assets, and to accelerate data and visualization work, while meeting the team’s quality and governance standards.
* **Automation:** Build and maintain automation using Google Apps Script / JavaScript and Google Sheets — refresh, consolidation, and delivery workflows — and support pipelines in the GCP environment where applicable.
* **Intake \& iteration:** Take on new reporting requests and re\-cuts of existing reports, run and monitor scheduled refreshes, and fix broken views or data connections.
* **Standards \& documentation:** Work to the architecture and specifications set by the senior team, follow visual/UX, naming, and governance standards, and document what you build.

**Qualifications/Skills:*** 3–4 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data / reporting development.
* Hands\-on data skills: importing data from multiple sources, building ETL and transformations, and validating and reconciling data for accuracy.
* Solid data\-visualization ability, including a working knowledge of chart and graph types and how to present data clearly to a business audience.
* Practical experience using AI tools to generate or accelerate dashboards, visuals, or analysis.
* Comfortable working to specifications and standards set by a senior team, with strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
* Familiarity with the GCP infrastructure is an asset.

**Required Tools \& Technical Proficiencies:*** **BI \& visualization:** Tableau, Looker Studio, and Google Apps Script dashboards; strong grasp of chart/graph selection and data\-visualization practice.
* **Data \& ETL**: SQL, ETL / data transformation, and data validation and reconciliation; Tableau Prep Builder.
* **Automation**: Google Apps Script / JavaScript and Google Sheets.
* **Source systems**: experience importing/integrating data from systems such as Salesforce, Workday, 6Sense, Finance systems, Symphoni, and SAP/HR.
* **AI\-assisted development**: hands\-on use of AI tools to generate dashboards, visuals, and reporting assets.
* **Cloud (asset)**: familiarity with the GCP infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Voyager (94001\), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
Senior Associate, Business Analysis
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting\-edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.


Today, we are a high\-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.


As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world\-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

**Team Description**


Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise\-wide customer resolution, serving as the one\-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).


We are not just improving processes; we are completely re\-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.

**Role Description**


General responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* **Bridge Business and Data:** Partner with cross\-functional teams (Tech, Lines of Business, Product) to translate complex data requirements into actionable product features for the Customer Navigator platform.
* **Analytical Problem Solving:** Support the business strategy by analyzing data to identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI for predicting, understanding, and resolving complaints before they escalate.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Act as a liaison between business users and the product team; gather feedback, understand processes, uncover opportunities to improve decision\-making, and drive continuous improvement in workflows.
* **Data Translation:** Interpret and translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that inform complaint resolution strategies.
* **Communication:** Communicate technical concepts and research results effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and non\-specialist colleagues, through structured presentations and storytelling.
* **Execution Focus:** Display an intense focus on achieving both short\- and long\-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.

**The ideal candidate is:**

* **Inquisitive:** You thrive on solving big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* **Technical:** You’re comfortable navigating complex analytical solutions and have hands\-on experience conducting business analyses using modern data tools.
* **Innovative:** You continually are on the lookout for novel approaches, solutions, and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to solve business problems and improve the customer experience.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, Econometrics, Finance or Operations Research).
* At least 2 years of professional work experience in analytics, business analysis or data\-driven product management.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of experience with Python, R, SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in the financial services industry, specifically dealing with cross\-LOB operations, customer experience or complaint resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy, and proficiency in key econometric and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, regression modeling, etc.).
* Experience translating ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and tangible product features.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

*At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.*


No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

Business Analyst \- Data Systems
  
About the Role
  
The Business Systems Analyst supports the organization’s data technology ecosystem by ensuring systems operate efficiently, reliably, and securely. This role is responsible for maintaining system performance, executing system changes, troubleshooting incidents, and optimizing workflows through data and automation tools. The Business Systems Analyst collaborates with cross\-functional teams to support upgrades, testing, and training while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  
  

Primary Responsibilities
  
* Monitor and maintain system uptime, data integrity, and overall performance.
* Evaluate and execute new system implementations, enhancements, and upgrades to optimize usability and efficiency.
* Manage the full lifecycle of system changes: planning, assessment, testing, deployment, validation, and documentation.
* Serve as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are accurately understood, implemented, and supported.
* Analyze data issues across integrated systems and work with technical teams to resolve root causes.
* Diagnose, log, and resolve or escalate incidents; perform root cause analysis and propose long\-term corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain system documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), FAQs, and configuration records.
* Support and optimize business workflows using SQL queries, reporting tools, and process automation platforms.
* Manage system access controls, roles, and permissions to ensure compliance and security.
* Assist in user training and create training materials to promote system adoption and effective usage.
* Collaborate with business users to identify areas for improvement and support digital transformation initiatives.


Required Qualifications

* Take on a critical role defining and realising fantastic solutions, processes, benefits and new opportunities to deliver to our stakeholders
* You'll be working in a vibrant, forward looking team and helping us to shape the future of our business
* It’s a great chance to hit the ground running, take advantage of our development opportunities, and advance your career
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 In your new role, you’ll be supporting the analysis of complex cross franchise and pan bank requirements, while capturing, validating and documenting business and system requirements and making sure that they are in line with key strategic principles. In the course of your work, we’ll also look to you to build, manage and maintain a positive working relationship with stakeholders and third party suppliers across multiple franchises and functions.
   

  

 You’ll also:
   

  

* Create and maintain documentation, as well as support controls and quality assurance for key stakeholders and suppliers
* Identify and support cut\-over and implementation tasks
* Trace and link business requirements to future state design
* Create and execute test scenarios and test scripts at various stages of the project in order to validate the solution design
* Facilitate user acceptance testing and support business users in executing the user acceptance testing


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 You'll need at least eight years of experience in business analysis and along with business analyst certification, such as BAX, CPRE and CBAP. Additionally, you’ll have an experience in delivering mobile and digital banking solutions across Commercial and Retail Banking, with expertise in iOS and Android platforms and Agile delivery.
   

  

 You’ll also need:
   

  

* Experience of account lifecycle management, payments, and transaction banking, including faster Payments, BACS, CHAPS, SWIFT, international payments, and real\-time payment solutions
* Experience in debit and credit card products, covering card lifecycle management, servicing, digital wallets, card controls, and customer\-facing digital capabilities
* Strong stakeholder management skills, process analysis, and translating business needs into scalable digital solutions along with the ability to collaborate with cross functional teams

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**We’re looking for a Business Analyst** 




 Snabbit is India’s first Quick\-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust.
 



 Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit is on a mission to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. We’ve already completed thousands of jobs with exceptional customer satisfaction — and we’re just getting started.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and execution\-oriented Business Analyst to help solve complex business problems and support data\-driven decision\-making across Snabbit.
 



 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams—including Operations, Category, Product, Growth, and Finance—to identify opportunities, track business performance, improve processes, and drive high\-impact initiatives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, finding patterns, and converting insights into measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Analyse business performance across cities, categories, and customer segments.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance trackers for key business metrics.
* Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities through structured data analysis.
* Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations for business teams.
* Work closely with Operations, Product, Growth, Category, and Finance teams on strategic projects.
* Track metrics such as demand, fulfilment, customer retention, service quality, productivity, and unit economics.
* Conduct root\-cause analyses to understand performance deviations and operational challenges.
* Support business planning, forecasting, target setting, and performance reviews.
* Design and evaluate experiments aimed at improving customer experience, operational efficiency, and business growth.
* Automate recurring reports and improve the accuracy and efficiency of decision\-making processes.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of analytical projects—from defining the problem to implementing and measuring solutions.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 3\-6 years of experience in business analytics, strategy, operations, consulting, or a similar role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a structured approach to ambiguous problems.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience analysing large datasets.
* Familiarity with visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Metabase.
* Strong business judgement and the ability to connect data insights with business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and a bias for action.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience in a consumer internet, marketplace, hyperlocal, logistics, or high\-growth startup.
* Exposure to Python or other analytical tools.
* Understanding of marketplace metrics, customer funnels, operational efficiency, and unit economics.
* Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders.



  





 Apply here \- https://forms.gle/ysZvCphdh1jMhzU89

**Description**
 Are you customer obsessed, smart and analytical, execution focused, hungry and passionate about e\-commerce, and with a strong work ethic? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you.
   

  

 The Amazon Selling Partner Developer Services team is hiring for an experienced Business Analyst who is a quick learner and can work independently. He/she should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where timely delivery is critical. The candidate will need to balance technical and business judgment to help inform a global risk operations team on the trending behaviors of Sellers, Vendors, and Solution Providers utilizing Seller Partner API (SP\-API).
   

  

 To be successful in this role you should have superior communication, presentation and organizational skills. Operating in a fast\-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment you will work autonomously taking control and responsibility for achieving the objectives of the role. This role provides opportunities to develop original ideas, approaches, and solutions in a competitive and ever changing business climate.
   

  

 The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. She/he is an expert with data modeling, ETL design and business intelligence tools. She/he is a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, pays careful attention to detail, and enjoys working in a fast\-paced team that continuously learns and evolves on a day to day basis
   

  

 About the Role: We are looking for a hands\-on, detail oriented and highly motivated data analyst to help create data backed insights. The candidate should be comfortable interfacing with technology systems and be able to analyze data and gather actionable conclusions. Operating in a rapidly changing environment will require the candidate to be adept at dealing with ambiguous, new and challenging situations. The candidate will be comfortable in executing repeatable processes. The candidate should also have an excellent understanding of SQL and query development, good business acumen and the ability to work with quantitative and business teams.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions
* Understand Amazon Seller Services products and services and track/report business performance and problem areas using appropriate metrics
* Use Amazon’s tools to problem solve and validate solutions
* Partner with global teams to define and track goals around key operational metrics
* Help identify process improvement opportunities to build streamlined and scalable solutions
* Ensure data accuracy by validating data for new and existing tools. Learn and understand a broad range of Amazon's data resources and know how, when, and which to use and which not to use.


 This position is based in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with Excel
* Experience with SQL
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree or above in business or analytical discipline
* 5\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience with handling of large datasets

The Data team is responsible for providing all reporting solutions required by the WHS Organization to drive workplace safety and regulatory compliance worldwide. This BA role will primarily support the data and reporting needs for the Safety Performance Insights (SPI) BI team in the WHS Organization. The role requires BA to identify the metrics and the dimensions that provide deep insights into program performance and also partner closely with the business to define the scope and the roadmap for the analysis, with an eye on both short term asks and long terms needs from a BI standpoint. This role requires to partner closely with Data Engineering teams to design the required data assets and where needed to partner with other business teams to study the cross\-effects of safety programs on other business areas and processes.

* Experience with SQL or ETL
